description: ISS-014 root cause fix: PipeWire SHM fallback delivers XR24 (packed BGRx, 4 B/px). NVENC backend allocates NV12 buffers but copies packed XR24 bytes directly into planar NV12 memory, causing deterministic vertical striping. Fix: add BT.709 limited-range XR24/AR24→NV12 conversion in push_frame, keep NV12/P010 fast paths byte-identical. Related: T-030, T-031, T-032.
title: Convert packed XR24/BGRx SHM frames to NV12 before NVENC submission
